primary_statistic: Pearson correlation of all-root configuration means with full-trace Ds
secondary_tests: Holm-adjust persistence-within and conductance-within; no causal claim
finite_size_policy: Primary descriptive finite-volume Ds retained; stationary-floor flags reported, not post-hoc discarded
null_policy: Whole-geometry label permutations for primary; root permutation controls are diagnostic, not exchangeability claims for spatially correlated roots
